fields.status: Substituted by House Substitute 1 for HB 233 on 2026-05-21; substitute signed and effective 2026-08-26 (85 Del. Laws ch. 440).
fields.key_provisions: Enacted House Substitute 1 covers large energy use facilities under alternative 75 MW/85%-load-factor, 100 MW instantaneous-demand, or 30 MW NAICS 518210 thresholds, with aggregation and specified exclusions. Requires utility rate classifications and service/security agreements to allocate costs and protect reliability. The 180-day rate-filing deadline runs from finalization of Commission regulations, not enactment.
